description: This file defines a base class for smart turn analysis using machine learning models, including configuration parameters, audio buffering, turn detection logic, and abstract prediction method. It is part of a speech processing system for end-of-turn detection.

classes.name: SmartTurnParams
classes.description: Configuration parameters for smart turn analysis, including silence duration, pre-speech audio, and max segment duration.

classes.name: SmartTurnTimeoutException
classes.description: Exception raised when smart turn analysis times out.

classes.name: BaseSmartTurn
classes.description: Abstract base class for smart turn analyzers using ML models, handling audio buffering, turn detection, and requiring subclasses to implement prediction logic.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the smart turn analyzer with optional sample rate and configuration parameters.

methods.name: speech_triggered
methods.description: Property indicating if speech has been detected and turn analysis is active.

methods.name: params
methods.description: Property returning current smart turn parameters.

methods.name: append_audio
methods.description: Appends raw audio data and speech detection flag for turn analysis, updating internal state and determining if turn has ended.

methods.name: analyze_end_of_turn
methods.description: Asynchronously analyzes current audio buffer to determine if turn has ended, returning state and metrics.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Resets the internal state of the turn analyzer.

methods.name: _clear
methods.description: Internal method to clear state based on turn completion status.

methods.name: _process_speech_segment
methods.description: Processes accumulated audio buffer with ML model to predict turn end, returning state and metrics data.

methods.name: _predict_endpoint
methods.description: Abstract method to be implemented by subclasses for ML-based end-of-turn prediction from audio data.
